solutionSql:
SELECT s.id,
       s.customer_id,
       s.weight_kg
FROM shipments s
WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 40
  AND s.weight_kg > (
    SELECT AVG(s2.weight_kg)
    FROM shipments s2
    WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
  )
ORDER BY s.id;

ambiguities.phrase: whose weight is greater than the average weight of all shipments with the same customer_id
ambiguities.readingChosen: The average covers all of that customer's shipments with a recorded weight, whatever their id.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: The average covers only that customer's shipments with ids 1 through 40, matching the scope of the outer rows.

notes: Twenty-one rows. A shipment with a NULL weight drops out because the comparison is not true. The average is taken over each customer's full history, which the word all supports.
